# KPI: Revenue per Salesperson
**Domain:** Sales | **Owner:** Sales Analytics | **Refresh:** Monthly
**Definition:** Average revenue generated by each sales representative.
**Formula:** Total Revenue / Number of Sales Reps
**Source Tables:** fact_sales, dim_employee
**Used In Reports:** Sales Pipeline Dashboard (Power BI), Regional Sales Detail (SSRS)
**Notes:** Revenue per Salesperson is part of the Sales KPI catalog.
